_comment: HUMAN listening verdicts. Hand-written, never generated -- no tool may rewrite this file, because the whole value of it is that a person said so. abpage.py reads it and shows the verdict on each tune's page and in the index. Key by the staged tune name (the .sid stem).
_staleness: `sng_sha256` is the sha256 of the .sng the listener approved, and it is what decides whether the verdict still holds -- NOT `version`. Keying on the version was the first design and it was wrong: v0.5.370 and v0.5.371 changed only abpage.py, which cannot alter one byte of audio, and both invalidated ACE_II's approval. That is this repo's own passthrough-guard lesson wearing different clothes -- a staleness check must key on the thing that would make the verdict lie (the conversion changing), never on a proxy that moves more often (any version bump). `version` is kept as provenance only, so a reader knows when the listening happened.

ACE_II.note: Approved after the wave-program slide travel, the filter cutoff step, the bit-6 rest envelope silence and the vibrato depth fix. The depth change itself was not audible to the listener -- this signs off the tune as it stands, not that change in isolation.

Action_Biker.note: Approved on audio re-staged after f63caa1. The listener confirms it is the same subtune on both sides and that they sound very close -- which closes the original complaint, 'the original's channel 3 is channel 2 in H2G'. The channels were never wrong; our .sng had played its SUBTUNES in the wrong order, because the selector named a six-byte scratch buffer ($C3F3) where the track table is ($C3F9). APPROVED WITH ONE KNOWN, UNFIXED DEFECT, recorded here so this sign-off is not read as covering it: our conversion is LONGER than the original. Traced 180 s both sides, the original makes 291 attacks and stops at 59.54 s; ours makes 856 and loops every 61.44 s forever. Per loop ours carries 52/52/187 attacks per voice against the original's 52/52/187 in total, so the music is right and only the ending is wrong -- Hubbard's $FE means 'tune ended' and a Goattracker orderlist cannot say it. This is the +-5 second length rule in CLAUDE.md and todo.md; the verdict signs off how the tune SOUNDS, not how long it runs.
